Alex: Clearing out some gear before moving next week 1 free items: 1) Samsung 34\" ultrawide (100hz, USB-C PD) 2) two SXSW weekend passes (I can't make it) 3) standing mat. Pickup Mission Bay bench. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/example
Jordan: Wow the passes! What dates are they for?
Alex: March 12-14 weekend, digital transfer ok.
Sofia: I'm interested in one pass if Jordan doesn't want both. Can you transfer via Eventbrite?
Ken: I can take the monitor if it's still available. Will pick up Thu evening. Any dead pixels?
Alex: No dead pixels, slight scuff on back corner. Comes with USB-C cable but no VESA.
Jordan: Passes sound great but I only need one. Sofia, want to split? Whoever DM's Alex first gets priority.
Sofia: DM sent. Also re: monitor, Ken if you want help carrying it I'm free Thu 6:15.
Ken: Thanks! I'll coordinate. Alex, can you hold the monitor until Fri 5pm? I won't be in the office Thu night.
Alex: Yep holding till Fri 5pm. If no one claims pass 2 by EOD Wednesday it's yours, Jordan.
ops-bot: Reminder: please label items with your name + date and don't leave items overnight on shared benches without facilities approval.
Alex: Good call. @facilities can we reserve Bench A for Fri pickup?
facilities: Bench A reserved for Alex from 4pm-6pm Fri. Please put a note and avoid blocking the walkway.
Jordan: Awesome, thanks Alex and facilities. Sofia, if you can't take the pass I'll grab it.
Sofia: Claimed via DM, thanks Alex!
Ken: I'll meet at 5:10pm Friday and grab the monitor. Appreciate folks helping carry.
Alex: Thanks everyone. If anything changes I'll update here. :thumbsup:
